mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not lead to wage inflation within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with positive economic sentiment within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM decrease > 2% does not lead to negative economic indicators within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5% does not lead to tighter financial conditions within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong demand across both consumer and housing sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with positive economic sentiment within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not lead to negative economic indicators within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1%, or FEDFUNDS < 1% does not lead to accommodative financial conditions within 3 months.
